summary.intent: Capture staging performance baselines for the BYO IPFS feature after its staging deployment, to understand infrastructure capacity when IPFS workload is offloaded.
summary.outcome: A new planning todo was created and committed for running BYO IPFS load test baselines on staging, and the project STATE.md was updated to reflect this pending work.

repo: Project uses a file-based planning system at .planning/ with todos stored as markdown files under .planning/todos/pending/, named with date slugs.
STATE.md at .planning/STATE.md tracks overall project state and is updated alongside todo creation.
workflow: Duplicate todo checks are performed before creating new todos to avoid redundancy.
Todo creation involves generating a slug, writing a markdown file, updating STATE.md, and committing all changes together.

open_items: Run BYO IPFS load tests on staging to capture performance baselines and determine max users supported with IPFS workload offloaded.
Analyze baseline results to inform infrastructure capacity planning decisions.
